title: Normalized fibre dimensions and constructible rank refinements
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$, and $X$ a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and finite intermediate fields $E\subset L$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Write $A_E=\mathcal O_E$, choose a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and put $B_{E,X}=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(A_E/\varpi_E^n)_X$ and $E_X=B_{E,X}[1/\varpi_E]$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. These are the continuous completed coefficient sheaves on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the derived-complete constructible integral categories with compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], their raw rationalizations $D^b_c(X,E)$ [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], their bounded localized standard t-structures [prop-weil-localized-tstructure], and the pair category $D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], with the finite scalar functors $T_{L/E}$ and associators of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension].

Write $\mathscr A_E(Z)$ for the finite-stage standard heart, $J_Z$ for its continuous rational realization [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization], and $\omega_{\bar z,E}$ for the normalized exact finite-dimensional geometric fibre [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-exactness]. Its lattice prescription on an affine etale chart of a lisse stratum is $M_{\bar z}=\varprojlim_n(N_n)_{\bar z}$ and $\omega_{\bar z,E}(F)=M_{\bar z}[1/\varpi_E]$, with a fractional lattice arrow $u/\varpi_E^a$ acting by $\varpi_E^{-a}\varprojlim_n u_n$.

For $F\in\mathscr A_E(X)$ choose a finite locally closed stratification on which $J_XF$ is lisse. On every stratum $S$, identify the pulled condensed coefficient ring with the continuous coefficient ring $E_S=B_{E,S}[1/\varpi_E]$ through the canonical ring isomorphism compatible with coefficient maps [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-realizations]. Then the locally free rank loci of [det-lem-stratified-lattice-rank] are clopen subsets $S_r\subset S$, and only finitely many are nonempty. At every geometric point over $x\in S_r$, the normalized finite-level reductions of an etale lattice chart have rank $r$, their reconstructed integral fibre is free of rank $r$, and the normalized rational fibre is an $E$-vector space isomorphic to $E^r$ [lem-per-lisse-completed-system-comparison]. Consequently $r(x)=\dim_E\omega_{\bar x,E}(F)$ is independent of the geometric point over $x$, is locally constant on $S$ and has finite range. Two geometric fibres over the same underlying point are isomorphic as vector spaces, with no canonical isomorphism specified. These assertions include rank zero and disconnected strata; constant finite-level module stalks use the constant-section normalization [lem-pod-lisse-tensor-and-scalar-extension].

The nonempty $S_r$, for all strata and all ranks, form a finite locally closed stratification of $X$ [def-constructible-stratification]. The nonzero-fibre locus is exactly the union of the positive-rank members and is constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset]. If the scalar comparison of [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-scalar] is used, finite coefficient extension preserves these ranks and nonzero-fibre loci. If $V$ is the descended fibre of [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-common-stage], any object of the common-stage standard heart [lem-per-adic-common-stage-truncations] admits a finite-stage representative with these same ranks after extension to $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$; it has the same finite rank stratification and constructible nonzero locus. These rank and nonzero-locus assertions are independent of the representative and of all lattice charts.

source.place: Definitions 6.8.3 and 6.8.6; Proposition 6.8.4; rank refinement and Stacks Tag 005L, topology.tex lemma-constructible-Noetherian-space

proof.text: The field k is Noetherian, since its only ideals are 0 and k. Thus X is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian], its underlying space is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-scheme-closed-subsets-minimal], and every subset, in particular every stratum S, is quasi-compact by [lem-sfb-noetherian-space-compact-subsets]. By [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization], J_XF is a constructible module sheaf, so choose its finite locally closed lisse stratification. On each S use the actual coefficient ring isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-realizations] to view this restriction as a module over pulled condensed coefficients. An isomorphism of coefficient rings carries a free rank-r module to a free rank-r module: apply the ring isomorphism to each coordinate. Hence [det-lem-stratified-lattice-rank] applies and gives the disjoint clopen S_r covering S, with finitely many nonempty members.

source.place: Definitions 6.8.3 and 6.8.6; rank detail proof, clopen descent and quasi-compact finiteness; Stacks 01T6, 01OZ and 04ZA

proof.text: Fix a geometric point over x in S_r and an affine etale lattice chart U of the lisse stratum S' at x of an adapted stratification. By [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-exactness] such charts exist, their integral fibres M=\varprojlim_n(N_n)_{\bar x} are finite free, and their normalized rational fibres are M[1/\varpi_E]. By [lem-per-lisse-completed-system-comparison] the lattice N has actual quotients N_n=N/\varpi_E^nN and is reconstructed by their limit. Locally trivialize N pro-etale with rank s at a lift of x. Inverting \varpi_E gives a rank-s trivialization of the rational sheaf F|_U=N[1/\varpi_E]. Restricted to the locally closed S\cap S', which contains x, pro-etale trivializations of F|_S and of F|_{S'} restrict to trivializations of the same ranks, so after the ring identification of step 1 the covering-independent rank characterization of [det-lem-stratified-lattice-rank] forces s=r. Reducing it, the etale N_n of [lem-per-lisse-completed-system-comparison] are finite locally free of rank r, hence etale locally constant, and their stalks P_n=(N_n)_{\bar x} are free of rank r over A_E/\varpi_E^n; on constant charts the coordinate identification is the constant-section isomorphism of clause 1 of [lem-pod-lisse-tensor-and-scalar-extension]. The same node, clause 3 for A_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}\to A_E/\varpi_E^n, and the transition isomorphisms N_{n+1}\otimes A_E/\varpi_E^n\cong N_n give P_{n+1}\otimes A_E/\varpi_E^n\cong P_n, so P_{n+1}\to P_n is surjective with kernel \varpi_E^nP_{n+1}. Lift a basis of P_1 successively: a lift of a basis of P_n to P_{n+1} spans P_{n+1} by Nakayama over the local ring A_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}, hence is a basis since both are free of rank r. The compatible bases give P_n\cong(A_E/\varpi_E^n)^r compatibly with the transitions, so M\cong\varprojlim_n(A_E/\varpi_E^n)^r=A_E^r. Thus M is free of rank r and M[1/\varpi_E] is isomorphic to E^r.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(1),(4),(6); normalized lattice quotients and constant-section fibres

proof.text: It follows that r(x)=dim_E omega_{\bar x,E}(F) is r on S_r, for every geometric point over x. The clopen partition from step 1 therefore makes r(x) locally constant on S, with finite range. Two such geometric fibres over x are both isomorphic to E^r; composing one chosen basis isomorphism with the inverse of another gives an isomorphism between them. No basis or isomorphism is specified canonically. The same argument applies when r=0 (all modules displayed are zero) and makes no assumption that S is connected.

source.place: Definitions 6.8.3 and 6.8.6; consequences of steps 1 and 2

proof.text: Each S_r is open in S. Write S=U intersection C with U open and C closed in X, and write S_r=S intersection O with O open in X. Then S_r=(U intersection O) intersection C is locally closed in X; its scheme is the open subscheme \iota^{-1}(O)=Z\times_XO of the given stratum scheme \iota:Z\to X. By [lem-weil-pbc-immersion-base-change-lft](1) the projection Z\times_XO\to O is an immersion, a closed immersion into an open of O followed by an open immersion; since an open of O is open in X, the composite Z\times_XO\to X is an immersion with image S_r. The finitely many original strata and their finitely many nonempty rank pieces give a finite disjoint cover, hence a stratification in [def-constructible-stratification]. By [lem-sfb-noetherian-space-compact-subsets] every subset of X is quasi-compact, so every open is retrocompact: its intersection with any quasi-compact open is a quasi-compact subset. Consequently (U intersection O) and X minus C are retrocompact opens, and S_r=(U intersection O) minus (X minus C) is constructible by [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Finite unions are constructible by the same definition. By step 2 a fibre vanishes exactly on rank zero, so the nonzero-fibre locus is precisely the union of the positive-rank pieces. For empty X this is the empty stratification and empty union.

source.place: Tags 04ZA and 005L, lemma-Noetherian-quasi-compact and lemma-constructible-Noetherian-space; direct finite-difference verification

proof.text: When the specified scalar comparison is used, [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-scalar] identifies omega_{\bar x,L}(T_{L/E}F) with omega_{\bar x,E}(F) tensor_E L. On a rank-r piece choose the basis from step 2; the balanced tensor map (a_i)_i tensor b maps to (a_i b)_i and identifies E^r tensor_E L with L^r, whose inverse sends the i-th standard basis vector to e_i tensor 1. Thus the dimension is r also after extension, and the positive-rank locus is identical. This calculation allows arbitrary ramification because the cited comparison already concerns the actual completed scalar functor.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4 and Remark 6.8.15; specified finite scalar comparison followed by the finite-basis tensor calculation

proof.text: By [lem-per-adic-common-stage-truncations], every common-heart object is isomorphic to a finite-stage heart pair (E,F). By [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-common-stage], its descended fibre is omega_{\bar x,E}(F) tensor_E Qbar_l, naturally under such isomorphisms. The same basis calculation as in step 5 gives Qbar_l^r at every point of S_r. Thus the finite-stage rank stratification also stratifies this common-heart object, and its nonzero locus is the same constructible union. Another representative gives an isomorphic descended fibre at each geometric point by that functor's representative independence, so its dimension and vanishing agree pointwise. At finite stage all lattice/chart choices give isomorphic normalized fibres by [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-exactness]. Hence all claimed ranks and nonzero loci are independent of the representative, chart, lattice and choices. Different initial stratifications can give different partitions, but refine the same intrinsic pointwise rank function.

I read all 6 steps and every cited statement, BS Prop. 6.8.4 (pdf pp. 58-60) and the main-20261015 lem-per-smooth-pullback-t-exact first paragraph; no SGA is cited. Steps 1, 3, 5 and 6 hold on their cited statements: the k-Noetherian chain gives DCC and quasi-compact strata; the coefficient-ring iso puts the restriction in the form det-lem-stratified-lattice-rank needs, giving clopen ranks; the scalar node's beta gives E^r tensor L = L^r; the common-stage truncations and V give Qbar^r and representative independence. I made two repairs, both in fixes/dag/nodes/sec-deligne-laumon-a1/lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-rank-loci.json. (1) C4, step 2: the step took M/varpi^n M=(N_n)_x from def-per-adic-normalized-fibre-data, but that node's Lattice.quotient (AdicNormalizedFibreData.lean:133) is a sheaf-level cokernel, not a stalk identity. The step also compared the rank on the chart stratum S' with the rank on S without saying so. The rewrite restricts both trivializations to S cap S' to get s=r, gets free stalks P_n from clause 1 of lem-pod-lisse-tensor-and-scalar-extension and P_{n+1} tensor A/varpi^n = P_n from clause 3 plus the transition isos of lem-per-lisse-completed-system-comparison, and lifts bases by Nakayama, so M=A^r. The def-per-adic citation is dropped. (2) C1, step 4: the immersion structure on the rank pieces, needed for def-constructible-stratification, was used without a citation. I added lem-weil-pbc-immersion-base-change-lft(1), marked the step non-elementary and added a tool_uses entry. proof_deps is now the union of uses.
